turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I have nausea—I’ve also vomited several times or made several efforts to vomit. I have severe pain too: intensity 8/10, and it comes on very fast (pace 10/10). The pain is in my upper chest, belly, and epigastric area, and it radiates to my thoracic spine and my left scapula. The pain feels like a knife stroke, violent, sickening, and haunting.

[ASK] Do you have fever and/or productive cough (phlegm) suggesting an infection?
[ASK] Do you have sudden, sharp chest pain that is worse when you take a deep breath (pleuritic pain) or sudden shortness of breath?
[ASK] Are you currently experiencing sudden, sharp chest pain that is worse when you take a deep breath (pleuritic pain) and/or sudden shortness of breath?
I don’t know. I do have severe pain (8/10) that comes on very fast (pace 10/10), and it’s in my upper chest, belly, and epigastric area, radiating to my thoracic spine and my left scapula.
